notes.title: Level difficulty update
notes.content:
Hello!

Pictassembler has been updated with a new Level 6, and all other levels were moved down one for a total of 45 levels now. There has been feedback from multiple players indicating that Level 6 is a spike in difficulty, so I applied an intermediate level before it to help smooth out that progression. If you are past that level, then you will need to go back and beat it to be able to complete the game, but I'm sure at that point, the new inserted level will be trivial. Let me know if you have any questions! Now that this is out of the way, I can get to some more fun updates.
